items.fullText: 반도체 소부장 포스코퓨처엠, LG에너지솔루션과 7년간 72만톤 규모 공급 합의 발행일 : 2026-10-30 17:41 전자신문을 선호 매체로 추가 공유하기 페이스북 X(트위터) X(트위터) --> 메일 URL 복사 글자크기 설정 가 작게 가 보통 가 크게 포스코퓨처엠 포항 양극재 공장 전경 30일 포스코퓨처엠은 LG에너지솔루션과 '미래 협력 MOU'를 체결하고 급변하는 전기차(EV)·에너지저장장치(ESS) 시장과 글로벌 통상환경에 공동 대응하기 위한 협력 체계를 강화하기로 했다. 미래 협력 MOU에는 최근 이차전지업계에서 이슈가 되고 있는 리튬·인산·철(LFP)와 인조흑연 음극재를 포함해 Ultra Hi-Ni 양극재, 그리고 나트륨이온전지, 실리콘 음극재 등 차세대 제품 공급과 기술개발 협력 등이 포함됐으며, 양사는 시장 변화에 대응하기 위한 양·음극재 제품 다변화와 공급 로드맵을 구체화해 연내 정식계약을 체결할 계획이다. 이날 합의에 따라 포스코퓨처엠은 2027년부터 2033년까지 7년간 총 72만톤 규모의 양·음극재를 LG에너지솔루션에 공급하게 될 전망이다. 기존에 LG에너지솔루션에 공급하던 삼원계 니켈·코발트·망간(NCM) 양극재는 중·장기적으로 폐배터리에서 추출한 회수 금속 사용을 확대해 원가 경쟁력을 더욱 높이는 방안을 추진하고, 최근 AI 데이터센터 증설과 보급형 전기차 판매 확대로 수요가 급증하고 있는 LFP 양극재까지 협력 범위를 넓히기로 했다. 우선 포스코퓨처엠은 포항 양극재 공장 하이니켈 삼원계 양극재 생산라인을 LFP 양극재 생산라인으로 전환하는 작업을 속도감 있게 추진해 내년 초부터 LG에너지솔루션에 LFP 양극재를 본격 공급한다는 계획이다. 향후에는 포스코그룹의 아르헨티나 염호리튬을 활용하는 신공법을 개발해 원가경쟁력과 품질을 더욱 향상시킨 차세대 LFP 양극재를 공급한다는 방침이다. 또한 포스코퓨처엠은 배터리 급속충전 성능과 수명 향상에 유리해 수요가 꾸준히 증가하고 있는 인조흑연 음극재를 한국과 베트남에서 생산해 LG에너지솔루션에 공급한다. 김명희 기자 noprint@etnews.com

items.t: Big Tech’s $750 Billion AI Bet Confronts Slowing Core Growth
items.d: The core businesses of America’s technology giants — the advertising, consumer and retail machines propping up a collective $750 billion in artificial intelligence spending this year — are starting to show signs of slowing. In some cases, they’re being cannibalized by the very technology the firms are betting the house on.

items.t: Andy Jassy says Prime Video is on track to earn ‘tens of billions of dollars’
items.d: The success of blockbuster hits like "Project Hail Mary" and "Verity" is only part of the story, Amazon's CEO says.
items.fullText: It’s been four years since Amazon bought MGM for $8.5 billion . But coming off the blockbuster success of this year’s hit movie “Project Hail Mary,” Hollywood has become a lucrative business for the e-commerce giant. Prime Video, Amazon’s streaming service, “has emerged as a significant business with a revenue run rate in the tens of billions of dollars and is now profitable in its own right,” Amazon CEO Andy Jassy said on the quarterly earnings call on Thursday. Jassy had previously told investors in May that Prime Video was profitable , but being on track to generate tens of billions is a new detail. Amazon said its movie studio, Amazon MGM Studios, has brought in more than $1.2 billion in global box office sales so far this year, helped by hits like “Project Hail Mary” and “Verity.” “Project Hail Mary” grossed an estimated $684 million worldwide, according to The Numbers . Starring Ryan Gosling and based on Andy Weir’s novel , the film opened in theaters in March and became Amazon MGM Studios’ highest-grossing release, according to entertainment reports. (The studio also had at least one notable flop this year: “Melania.” ) Jassy also named a number of TV shows as hits, including “Carrie,” “The Summer I Turned Pretty,” “The Boys,” “Off Campus,” “Fallout,” and “Reacher.” Season 4 of “Reacher” drew 66 million viewers globally in its first 28 days, the company says, with more to come. Season 5 is filming now, and the show was picked up for a sixth season. (And if you don’t follow Alan Ritchson, the star of “Reacher,” on Threads, you are missing out on an actor who has turned a friendly-yet-witty reply into an art form.) items.t: AWS will be a $1T business, Jassy says — but first, it will spend big
items.d: Amazon wants to be the king of AI cloud computing and become the first $1 trillion revenue business. But to do that it will have to continue on its capex spending spree, its CEO said Thursday.
items.fullText: Andy Jassy has made it known that he believes AWS can be a trillion-dollar revenue business. During Amazon’s quarterly earnings call on Thursday, he repeated this ambition. “What we’re building at Amazon is unlike anything that’s ever been seen before. There has never been a business with a trillion dollars of annual revenue,” he said. However, before the cloud business gets there, Amazon is going to have to ramp up its capital expenditures to build out the infrastructure necessary to support that blossoming business. “We still expect 2026 cash capex of approximately $220 billion — the majority for AWS — and expect to spend meaningfully more in 2027, with a clear line of sight to attract its financial returns,” Jassy revealed on Thursday. Amazon’s big spending on its AI infrastructure buildout has been an ongoing source of concern for investors this year. Indeed, during Thursday’s call, Wall Street analysts repeatedly asked Jassy to explain the spending, the signals that the growth really will come, and the profit margins expected. Jassy told them it was all money well spent because the e-commerce giant planned to capitalize on a historic moment in global cloud demand driven by AI. AWS revenue increased 39% from the year-ago quarter, a trend of steady growth for the sixth straight quarter . And the CEO forecast that it would increase by 40% not just next year, but in 2028, too. “AWS is a $184 billion annualized revenue run-rate business, and yet the opportunity remains extraordinary,” Jassy enthused. “With our continued pace of innovation, new core and AI functionality, enterprises wanting to run their core and AI workloads in AWS, and the amount of capacity that we’re adding each year, we believe that AWS can grow north of 40% in each 2027 and in 2028, and be a trillion-dollar revenue business in the next five to 10 years.” Jassy added that the company was “in the very early d

items.t: GM reaches $220M settlement over selling drivers’ private data
items.d: As part of the settlement, GM must get drivers’ express consent before it collects or shares their driving and location data.
items.fullText: General Motors will pay $220 million to 36 states to settle allegations that it illegally sold private driving behavior and location information to data brokers. As part of the settlement, GM must get drivers’ express consent before it collects or shares their driving and location data — terms that are in line with separate agreements it previously reached with California and the Federal Trade Commission (FTC). This settlement does contain a new requirement that GM must have a third party assess the automaker’s compliance with the privacy program it has put in place. The agreement announced Thursday settles a lawsuit brought by a coalition of attorneys general from 36 states that alleged GM had sold the information to data brokers, which in turn then sold it to insurance providers. “This agreement addresses Smart Driver, a product we ended in 2024, and reinforces steps we’ve taken to strengthen our privacy practices,” GM said in an emailed statement. “Safer, more helpful and personalized experiences are enabled by connected vehicle data, and GM is committed to being clear about what information is used, how it’s protected, and the choices customers have about what they share.” The settlement comes more than two years after a New York Times report showed how GM and OnStar collected, used, and sold drivers’ precise geolocation data and driving behavior to third parties, including data brokers LexisNexis and Verisk. The data was collected through GM’s Smart Driver program, a free feature contained within its connected car apps that tracked and rated driving behaviors and seat belt use. Data brokers sold this information to insurance providers, which could affect customers’ rates, the NYT reported at the time. GM discontinued Smart Driver in 2024, but that didn’t stop legal action. items.t: As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience
items.d: As AI transforms how people find information online, Reddit is rethinking its open-web roots to protect its audience and business.
items.fullText: Reddit has long attracted millions of users to its site through Google, with many even appending the word “Reddit” to their search queries for better answers. But as search traffic dries up amid the shift to AI-powered search, Reddit is rethinking its relationship with the open internet. In its third-quarter earnings call on Thursday, the company announced it’s transitioning to a primarily “logged-in experience.” The move is designed to protect its data from AI scraping, allowing the company to instead forge lucrative licensing deals with model providers. But just as important, such a shift could help Reddit to increase its revenue even as it faces daily active user declines in its largest market, the U.S. Overall, Reddit’s global daily active users were flat quarter-over-quarter in Q3, reaching 130.3 million, while U.S. daily active users dropped from 53.2 million in Q2 to 50.7 million in Q3 and were down 2% year-over-year. Image Credits: Reddit The company is not alone in seeing such declines; the shift to an AI-centered web has impacted most websites and publishers by now, leading to fewer click-throughs, as AI summaries provide answers that don’t require website visits and Google’s traditional “ten blue links” have reduced relevance. (The change is now even impacting Google’s bottom line , its earnings revealed.) But at Reddit’s scale, the numbers associated with such a decline are enormous. The company said search traffic referrals dropped by more than 1 million referrals on average per week in October. It warned that if the trend continues, daily active users could decline to a low-double-digit percentage by next quarter. (To play that out: a hypothetical 10% to 12% decline could bring Reddit to roughly 115 million to 117 million daily actives, down from 130.3 million in Q3. That’s a huge drop!) items.t: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings acquires ADT
items.d: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings is buying ADT in a $15.3 billion deal, with plans to bring AI to the home security business.
items.fullText: In Brief Posted: 12:56 PM PDT · October 29, 2026 Image Credits: Timon Schneider/SOPA Images/LightRocket / Getty Images Julie Bort OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings acquires ADT Thrive Holdings has acquired physical security company ADT for $10 per share or about $7.6 billion in equity, the companies announced on Thursday. Beyond equity, the total enterprise value of the deal is $15.3 billion, ADT said. Thrive Holdings is the holding company spinout from Josh Kushner’s powerhouse VC firm Thrive Capital. It also counts OpenAI as its partner , as well as an investor. The firm’s mission is to hold other companies long-term, revitalizing them with AI. Currently, Thrive Holdings holds over 75 companies, it says. As a partner, OpenAI supplies AI models and tech as well as people, otherwise known as forward-deployed engineers, to Thrive’s companies. Neither ADT nor Thrive announced what new AI-powered security products they will be releasing, but they did tease that the plan was to invest and release new products. “ADT will form the foundation of Thrive Holdings’ smart home security business,” the press release said. AI-powered physical security is having a moment right now. Apple just entered the field with a new line of smart home and home security products in collaboration with LG and Schneider Electric. Amazon updated its smart home line, including new AI-powered home cameras . ADT already partners with Apple and Google and is expected to continue to do so. And who knows what the future might bring? Some startups are offering AI dog robots as roving security guards . Note: This story was updated to include ADT’s current partnerships and to describe Thrive Holdings as a holding company. items.fullText: Pioneers Across Europe Deploy NVIDIA Earth-2 Open Models to Power Real-World Weather and Climate Prediction October 21, 2026 by Niall Robinson 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Weather forecasts shape more than daily plans; timely weather information is crucial for energy producers, insurers and transport operators to plan around changing conditions. A global forecast can show a storm taking shape, but decisions about solar farms, shipping routes or insured property depend on what happens locally. NVIDIA Earth-2 gives developers and researchers a family of open AI models and tools they can customize with their own data. Running on NVIDIA computing, these technologies support global weather prediction, detailed regional forecasts and environmental research. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements StormScope EU is the latest model to join Earth-2 — a regional version of the StormScope model for short-term forecasting, trained over Europe weather and climate data. It uses EUMETSAT satellite observations to predict evolving cloud conditions across 16 Meteosat channels at 10-minute intervals. At GTC Berlin, NVIDIA is showcasing a live StormScope EU pipeline in an interactive weather demo built in partnership with Earthmover . The demo uses Earth2Studio to run forecasts and Earthmover’s data platform to manage and serve the real-time results, which are updated as soon as new satellite observations come in, every 10 minutes. Earthmover serves these results as map tiles, letting visitors explore predictions across Europe without downloading entire datasets. Developers can combine Earth-2 models in workflows tailored to regional needs, using StormScope for short-term forecasting and CorrDiff to add local detail to coarser weather data.
